Alice Chen: Hey team — quick design review: new spend summary vs ledger view toggles. Dropping screenshots in thread. Main question: should token breakdown be inline under chart or a collapsible side panel? cc @Diego (design) @Samir
Diego (Design): My vote: inline under chart for quick scan, but collapsible panel for deep dive. sharing mock: https://figma.redwood/s/abc123. prefer compact rows and a single-line summary above the chart.
Samir K.: Implementation note — inline means chart height shrinks; mobile becomes tricky. Collapsible side panel is easier to reuse across routes. Also perf: rendering token table for 10k rows will be heavy.
Priya A.: Accessibility nits: if collapsible, ensure focus is managed, keyboard toggle, and `aria-expanded` on the button. Also the sparkline legend colors need higher contrast (current ratio ~2.9:1).
Mallory G.: Data point: >60% of users go to 'Invoices' after checking spend; detailed token breakdown is used ~8% daily. Suggest default collapsed with a strong summary.
Alice Chen: Hmm interesting, Mallory. Suggest default collapsed but show a 'Quick breakdown' summary row (top 3 tokens + totals) directly under chart so users can scan without expanding.
Samir K.: Works for me. Quick dev ask: add an `Export CSV` CTA next to totals. If side panel is used, make export global to the route to avoid duplicating logic across components.
Diego (Design): Agree. Also copy tweak: change label from 'Token breakdown' -> 'Token usage by model' for clarity.
Priya A.: Also ensure invoice download status announces to SR users: "Invoice download in progress" / "Download complete". And add visible focus styles for the toggle.

QA Bot: I can add tests for keyboard nav and aria labels. Will need collapsed-state mocks and the summary row spec.
Alice Chen: :thumbsup: I'll update the Figma file and add a compact-row mock. @Diego can you post the collapsed mock by EOD?
Diego (Design): On it — will post two variants: 'summary-row' and 'side-panel-collapsed' by 5pm PST.
Samir K.: I'll scope in sprint planning. Rough estimate: 3 dev days if we implement side panel + export, 5 days if we do inline with virtualization.
Alice Chen: Decision for now: default collapsed with summary row visible. We'll measure engagement and revisit if needed. Thanks everyone!
